body_text:
The dual space $V^*=\operatorname{Hom}_F(V,F)$ is the vector
space of linear functionals on $V$. If $B=(b_1,\ldots,b_n)$ is
a basis, its dual basis $(b^1,\ldots,b^n)$ is characterized by
$b^i(b_j)=\delta^i_j$. The functional $b^i$ extracts the $i$th
coordinate relative to $B$.
